svt_mipi_lane_configuration Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_lane_configuration:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

This class represents lane related configuration. It includes the configuration of lane that applies to both CSI2 as well as DSI. It has the configuration fields like device type, lane active/passive, Timeout Counter for HS, LP of DPHY. It also has time for power reset, wake up and initialization values.

  function bit
 svt_mipi_lane_configuration::do_is_valid
 (  bit silent = 1, int kind = -1  ) 

Checks to see that the data field values are valid, focusing mainly on checking/enforcing valid_ranges constraint.

silent - It controls on error and warning message if transaction is not valid.

kind - This indicates the type of do_is_valid being requested.

Return values - It return 1 if transaction is valid else return 0.

 svt_sequence_item_base :: do_is_valid 

  function int
 svt_mipi_lane_configuration::get_packer_max_bytes_required
 (   ) 

This method returns the maximum packer bytes value required by the suite. This is checked against `SVT_XVM_UC(MAX_PACKER_BYTES) to make sure the specified setting is sufficient for CSI2/DSI.

The default implementation just returns `SVT_XVM_UC(MAX_PACKER_BYTES) value. Individual suites extend this method to indicate any specific requirements they may have.

 rand bit  attribute
 svt_mipi_lane_configuration::coding_8b9b_en = 1'b0

Bit field to enable 8b9b coding.
  • 1: Encodes 8bit data to 9-bit data and decodes 9-bit data to 8-bit data.
  • 0: No 8b9b encoding/decoding will be performed.

 bit  attribute
 svt_mipi_lane_configuration::ddr_clk_i_q_phase_shift_check_always_enable = 1'b0

To control checking of quadrature phase shift between DDR clocks TxDDRClkHS-I and TxDDRClkHS-Q.
  • 0: Check is enabled during SOT phase of HS transmission on DATA Lane.
  • 1: Check is always enabled.

 bit [1:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_lane_configuration::invalid_states_before_t_init[$]

This queue is used to insert invalid states before T_INIT (Initialization period) duration on all lanes (both clock and data lanes)

 integer  attribute
 svt_mipi_lane_configuration::invalid_states_within_t_init[$]

This queue is used to insert invalid states within T_INIT (Initialization period) duration on all lanes (both clock and data lanes) The first element is the timestamp at which user wants to insert error. It should be a integer value. The second element is the invalid value that user wants to send for a particular duration which is specified in third element. The user can repeat the 2nd and 3rd element pattern for any number of invalid states for any duration.

Member Typedef Documentation

 typedef enum  svt_mipi_lane_configuration::clock_type_enum
Enum used for clock type. Specification reference CSI2 1.1 Section 7.
CONTINUOUS
Indicates clock type CONTINUOUS.When selected, clock lane remains in HS mode even between the transmission of packets.
NON_CONTINUOUS
Indicates clock type NON_CONTINUOUS.When selected, clock lane enters LP-11 between the transmission of packets.

 typedef enum  svt_mipi_lane_configuration::device_type_enum
Enum used for lane device type.
CSI_XMTR( `SVT_MIPI_LANE_CSI_XMTR )
Indicates Lane Layer of CSI-XMTR Type.
CSI_RCVR( `SVT_MIPI_LANE_CSI_RCVR )
Indicates Lane Layer of CSI-RCVR Type.
DSI_HOST( `SVT_MIPI_LANE_DSI_HOST )
Indicates Lane Layer of DSI-HOST Type.
DSI_DEVICE( `SVT_MIPI_LANE_DSI_DEVICE )
Indicates Lane Layer of DSI-DEVICE Type.

 typedef enum  svt_mipi_lane_configuration::dphy_protocol_version_enum
Indicates the DPHY Specification Version of VIP with DPHY1.1 being the default version
DPHY_VERSION_11( `SVT_MIPI_DPHY_VERSION_11 )
DPHY Specification Version 1.1 and lower
DPHY_VERSION_12( `SVT_MIPI_DPHY_VERSION_12 )
DPHY Specification Version 1.2 and lower
DPHY_VERSION_20( `SVT_MIPI_DPHY_VERSION_20 )
DPHY Specification Version 2.0 and lower
DPHY_VERSION_21( `SVT_MIPI_DPHY_VERSION_21 )
DPHY Specification Version 2.1 and lower

 typedef enum  svt_mipi_lane_configuration::skew_after_ulps_enum
Indicates the type of skew which is to be expected after ULPS when DPHY Specification Version of VIP is DPHY 1.2.
NO_SKEW_AFTER_ULPS( `SVT_MIPI_NO_SKEW_AFTER_ULPS )
No Skew after ULPS.
INITIAL_SKEW_AFTER_ULPS( `SVT_MIPI_INITIAL_SKEW_AFTER_ULPS )
Initial Skew after ULPS.
PERIODIC_SKEW_AFTER_ULPS( `SVT_MIPI_PERIODIC_SKEW_AFTER_ULPS )
Periodic Skew after ULPS.

  constraint
 svt_mipi_lane_configuration::reasonable_timer_enable

Reasonable constraint for HS-TX, HS-RX, LP-TX and LP-RX timer enable.
constraint reasonable_timer_enable {
    if(device_type == CSI_XMTR || device_type == CSI_RCVR) {
       hs_tx_timer_enable == 1'b0;
       hs_rx_timer_enable == 1'b0;
       lp_tx_timer_enable == 1'b0;
       lp_rx_timer_enable == 1'b0;
    }
    else if (device_type == DSI_HOST)
    {
       hs_tx_timer_enable == 1'b1;
       lp_rx_timer_enable == 1'b1;
       hs_rx_timer_enable == 1'b0;
       lp_tx_timer_enable == 1'b0;
    }
    else {
       hs_tx_timer_enable == 1'b0;
       lp_rx_timer_enable == 1'b0;
       hs_rx_timer_enable == 1'b1;
       lp_tx_timer_enable == 1'b1;
     }
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_lane_configuration::solve_order

Order in which initialization periods should be solved.
constraint solve_order {
    solve t_por before t_init_master;
    solve t_init_slave before t_init_master;
  }

  constraint
 svt_mipi_lane_configuration::valid_ranges

Valid constraints definitions.
constraint valid_ranges {
    solve device_type before hs_tx_timer_enable
                             ,hs_rx_timer_enable
                             ,lp_tx_timer_enable
                             ,lp_tx_timer_enable
                             ,ta_to_timer_en
                             ,pr_to_timer_en
                             ,clock_type;
     initial_skew_cal_timer inside {[ : initial_skew_max_clock_cycles]};
    alternate_cal_timer inside {[ : alternate_cal_max_clock_cycles]};
    periodic_skew_cal_timer inside {[ : periodic_skew_max_clock_cycles]};
    (insert_leader_sync_pattern_during_settle == 1) -> (insert_skew_sync_pattern_during_settle != 1);
    (insert_skew_sync_pattern_during_settle == 1) -> (insert_leader_sync_pattern_during_settle != 1);
    num_of_steps_ssc >= 4;
  }
